remarks: Tucked away on a quiet dead-end street in East Norwalk, this beautifully refreshed apartment offers privacy, comfort, and convenience. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 1 full bathroom, the home has been recently updated with fresh paint, new carpeting, an upgraded kitchen, and a renovated bath. The flexible layout provides comfortable living space with one bedroom on the main level and two additional bedrooms upstairs. Bright rooms and abundant natural light create a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout. Additional highlights include on-site laundry, private parking for 3-4 vehicles, and a designated outdoor area perfect for relaxing, grilling, or outdoor dining. Conveniently located just minutes from I-95, the Merritt Parkway, shopping, dining, schools, and everyday amenities, this well-maintained rental offers the perfect combination of peaceful living and commuter convenience. Immediate occupancy available.
